crossRefs.note: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax…
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.
When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!”
But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by…
“He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’”
They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of…

translations.web: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,
translations.bsb: On receiving their pay, they began to grumble against the landowner.
translations.kjv: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
translations.asv: And when they received it, they murmured against the householder,
